items.title: UNICAF Scholarships for Online MS/PhD Degrees at UK Universities
items.summary: The UNICAF Scholarship programme offers a unique opportunity for students in Pakistan and India to pursue online Master's and PhD degrees from reputable UK universities. It supports learners facing financial constraints while allowing them to study flexibly alongside work or personal commitments. Graduates receive a globally recognised UK degree that can accelerate career growth.
items.meta_description: Explore UNICAF Scholarships for online MS/PhD degrees at UK universities. Apply now to earn a recognised qualification, boost your career and gain recognition.
eligibility: Hold a recognised bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Demonstrate English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL or equivalent).
Show academic merit or relevant professional experience.
benefits: Partial or full tuition fee coverage for the chosen online programme.
Award of a UK university degree that is internationally respected.
how_to_apply: Visit the UNICAF website, browse available UK online MS/PhD programmes and select your preferred course.
Complete the online application form and upload required documents (transcripts, English test scores, CV).
Submit the application and wait for the scholarship decision via email.

faqs.q: What types of programmes are covered by UNICAF scholarships?
faqs.a: UNICAF funds online Master's (MS) and Doctoral (PhD) programmes offered by partner UK universities.

faqs.q: Can students from Pakistan and India apply?
faqs.a: Yes, the scholarship is open to eligible applicants from Pakistan, India and other countries worldwide.

items.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarships for MS & PhD – Pakistan & India Applicants
items.summary: The Gates Cambridge Scholarship is a world‑renowned award that funds graduate study at the University of Cambridge. It covers full tuition, a generous living stipend, and travel costs for selected MS and PhD candidates. Applicants from Pakistan and India are strongly encouraged to apply, as the program seeks diverse global talent. The scholarship aims to develop future leaders who will make a positive impact in their home countries and beyond.
items.meta_description: Discover the prestigious Gates Cambridge Scholarships for MS and PhD studies. Open to Pakistani and Indian students, these fully funded awards cover tuition, living costs, and travel to Cambridge University.

Accepted offer for a full‑time MS or PhD programme at the University of Cambridge.
Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and a commitment to improving the lives of others.
benefits: Full tuition fees, a monthly stipend for living expenses, and travel costs to and from Cambridge.

faqs.q: Can I apply for the Gates Cambridge Scholarship if I am studying a non‑science subject?
faqs.a: Yes. The scholarship is open to all disciplines offered at Cambridge, including arts, humanities, social sciences, engineering, and natural sciences.

faqs.q: Do I need to be a resident of Pakistan or India at the time of application?
faqs.a: Residency is not required; you only need to hold citizenship of Pakistan, India, or any other non‑UK country.

items.title: ETH Zurich Excellence Masters Scholarships – Study in Switzerland
items.summary: The ETH Zurich Excellence Masters Scholarships offer top-performing students from Pakistan, India and around the world a chance to pursue a master's degree at one of Europe's leading universities. Recipients receive full tuition coverage, a monthly living stipend, and health insurance for the duration of their studies. The program aims to attract diverse talent to ETH Zurich's cutting‑edge research and education environment. Applications are competitive and based on academic excellence, motivation, and leadership potential.
items.meta_description: Explore ETH Zurich Excellence Masters Scholarships for Pakistani and Indian students. Full tuition and living support for top‑ranked Swiss master’s programs.
eligibility: Bachelor’s degree with at least a 3.0 GPA (or equivalent) from a recognized university.
Citizenship of Pakistan, India, or any other country with a strong academic record.
Proficiency in English (IELTS/TOEFL) – German or French language skills are optional but advantageous.
benefits: Full tuition waiver for the entire master’s program.
Monthly living allowance, health insurance, and support for study-related expenses.

Submit the scholarship application together with transcripts, CV, motivation letter, and two recommendation letters.

faqs.q: Who can apply for the ETH Zurich Excellence Masters Scholarship?
faqs.a: The scholarship is open to outstanding students from any country, including Pakistan and India, who have completed a bachelor’s degree and meet the academic criteria.

faqs.q: What does the scholarship cover?
faqs.a: It covers full tuition fees for the master’s program, a monthly stipend for living expenses, and health insurance for the duration of the study.
